related_questions.question: How long does COVID stay in your body after recovery?

text_blocks.snippet: While the acute phase of COVID-19 usually resolves within a couple of weeks, viral RNA can persist in the body for much longer, potentially up to a year or even two, according to a study by UC San Francisco. This persistence can occur even after the initial symptoms have subsided. The virus has been found in tissues and blood samples, suggesting it may linger and potentially contribute to long COVID symptoms in some individuals.
